messages:
Marta Gonzalez: Heading into publish window in ~30m. py/ts SDKs: wheels + sdists + npm. CI green but wheel-sign job showed intermittent failures earlier. Will start npm canary first for quick smoke. @Sam Choi @Kevin Wong are you on call?
release-bot: publish job queued: /jobs/publish/1761112222
Sam Choi: If signing is flaky, prefer npm canary only. Do NOT push dist-tag 'latest' until wheels are signed. Use dist-tag 'canary' for now. :warning:
Kevin Wong: Agree. Also propose enterprise pin: keep 2.3.x pinned for customers on older contracts. If wheel sig fails, fallback to 2.3.5 and notify account owners.
Carla Reyes: I'll prep release notes: include deprecation note for legacy sync client in 3.0 and add credential rotation blurb for ephemeral tokens.
Marta Gonzalez: Plan: start npm canary -> verify telemetry + smoke -> only publish wheels after signatures validated. If wheel signing fails 3 attempts, abort wheels and rollback npm canary by removing tag.
release-bot: publish: npm canary published @ 1761112300 (job 7834) :thumbsup:
Sam Choi: Running quick smoke: `pip install --index-url https://pypi.example/simple redwood-sdk==2.4.0rc1`
Kevin Wong: Reminder to update CHANGELOG with 'breaking: remove sync() from legacy client' and add migration snippet.
Carla Reyes: Added batching defaults blurb. Will push docs PR after wheel artifacts are green.
release-bot: signing: wheel-sign job failed attempt 1 (timeout) 1761112350
Marta Gonzalez: Ugh. Retrying signing, but if it fails again we should stop. @Sam Choi can you check KMS / signing logs?
Sam Choi: On it, checking KMS console... looks like HSM rotation happened at 02:13 UTC, might be the root cause. Pinging security.
Andrew (sec): HSM rotation completed, certs propagated. There was a short backlog; investigating catch-up, but no active errors in the KMS control plane right now.
release-bot: signing: wheel-sign job failed attempt 2 (sig mismatch) 1761112380
Kevin Wong: Given sig mismatch, we should not publish wheels. Abort final wheel publish and keep npm canary for internal QA only. Also suggest retagging 'canary' -> 'internal' so customers won't auto-get it.
Marta Gonzalez: Agreed. Do not push 'latest'. I'll de-tag 'latest' if set and retag to 'internal'. Notify support + enterprise contacts about pins and the hold. @Carla Reyes can you draft the internal note?
Carla Reyes: Drafted. Will post to #support and send to enterprise-subscribers list with rollback steps: npm unpublish canary + set enterprise pinned version to 2.3.5.
release-bot: npm: retagging completed 1761112400
Sam Choi: :ok_hand: I'll open a follow-up to harden wheel signing flow / KMS handling and add a preflight to block GA until signatures validate.
Marta Gonzalez: We're pausing final GA to avoid shipping bad artifacts. Schedule follow-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks all for the quick responses.
